description: Shows the team's profile and settings: name, website, description, support email, brand colours, branded-app AI switches and client settings. Use when the user asks how the team is set up, what a setting is now, or before changing settings. Not for the Brand Kit voice rules (use get_brand_kit) or plan limits (use get_team_usage). Returns the profile fields; never API keys, payment or billing details.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: get_team_profile
title: Get team profile and settings
